A witness restart leaves the epoch open; a pre-commit crash leaves no partial content and the retry runs inside the same frozen window; a post-commit crash replays idempotently. custodyctl records a durable fence intent before asking the witness to freeze, so a crash in the handshake resumes the same epoch.
